hooks.name: before-spec-task
hooks.description: Point the agent at the spec files before a task runs.

action.prompt: Before this spec task, re-read requirements.md or bugfix.md, design.md, and the task's _Requirements_ ids. Implement only that task.

hooks.name: after-spec-task
hooks.description: Ask the agent to compare the diff with the task's acceptance criteria.

action.prompt: Compare the change you just made with the acceptance criteria cited by the task. Report any criterion that is still unmet. Do not start the next task.
